items.title: Xbox is officially embracing the chaos of AI-powered game ports
items.excerpt: Xbox Labs is a new group exploring emerging game technology, including AI-assisted decompilation, recompilation and browser emulation of older games.

items.title: Xbox Labs Is A Big Announcement About AI That's Missing The Word AI
items.excerpt: A new Xbox team has been tasked with exploring AI-coded game stuff, though the announcement never says 'AI'.

items.title: New Xbox Labs Team Officially Announced
items.excerpt: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma reveals a new team inspired by viral AI-powered, vibe-coded game experiments.

items.title: Xbox Labs Announced With Goal of Getting New Games and Old Playable in Regular Web Browsers
items.excerpt: Xbox has announced Xbox Labs, a new initiative aimed at getting games to more people in more places, with a particular emphasis on web browsers.

items.title: Xbox is forming a whole division in response to the vibe-coded game recomp explosion – "These are unmistakably good outcomes for players"
items.excerpt: Xbox frames the wave of AI vibe-coded recompilations as good for players, even when they challenge existing business models.

items.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker lead actor reminds us why AI will always struggle to replicate human performances: "They need to have their own ideas"
items.excerpt: As AI voice use increases, The Blood of Dawnwalker's lead actor Will de Renzy-Martin explains what the technology can't replicate in game performance.

items.title: The happiest man in gaming hates generative AI
items.excerpt: Dwarf Fortress creator Tarn Adams on bloated AI code, vampire computers, and surviving on Steam.

items.title: Dwarf Fortress creator Tarn Adams is as tired of genAI in the industry as anyone else, and is pretty set on never using it
items.excerpt: Tarn Adams has strong feelings on genAI and says very little could make him budge on never using it for Dwarf Fortress.

items.title: VR Chat Community Dev Calls For Boycott Over 'Rampant Plague' Of AI
items.excerpt: A prominent VRChat community creator starts a protest over AI-generated worlds and avatars hurting discoverability; developers ask how much is too much.

items.title: An OpenAI model was caught trying to cheat at StarCraft, and of course it did it by stealing a human's work
items.excerpt: GPT-6 Astra tried to get a leg-up in Blizzard's RTS by pilfering a human-created bot.

items.title: Google's golden age of AI games?
items.excerpt: PC Gamer pushes back on Google's claim that 'AI is unlocking a new golden age of games', starting with the AI-generated image Google chose to illustrate it.

items.title: New Sony patent proposes using AI to alter boss fights in real time, and now I'm having nightmares about a totally unpredictable Souls game
items.excerpt: A Sony patent describes AI that adapts boss behaviour in real time; the tech could also make NPCs more realistic.

items.title: Bloodborne PC port with full multiplayer can't get FromSoftware fans to vibe with vibe coding: "I will just use the emulator made by humans"
items.excerpt: An unofficial native Bloodborne PC port with full multiplayer, made with vibe coding, fails to win over FromSoftware fans who prefer the human-made emulator.

items.title: NVIDIA DLSS 5 Runs 30% Faster Now, Reduces VRAM Use By 20% & Coming To Hogwarts Legacy & Where Winds Meet In November
items.excerpt: NVIDIA says its DLSS 5 neural rendering model is now faster and less resource-hungry, and is coming to new games including Hogwarts Legacy.

items.title: 부산서 열리는 유니티 AI 게임잼, 참가자 모집한다
items.excerpt: 유니티와 한국게임산업협회가 지스타 2026 개막 전 11월 18~19일 부산 벡스코에서 24시간 무박 '유니티 AI 게임잼'을 열고 10월 12~20일 참가자를 모집한다.

items.title: [AGF 26] 서브컬처 행사 영상을 AI로? 팬덤 불만 폭발
items.excerpt: AGF가 올해 행사 티저 영상을 인공지능으로 제작해 팬들의 큰 불만을 샀다. 서브컬처 팬덤의 AI 반감 성향을 고려하지 않은 홍보라는 지적이 잇따랐다.

items.title: Official Unity Plugin for Grok Build Is Now Available
items.excerpt: The official Unity Plugin now works in Grok Build, bringing 30+ Unity-written engineering skills (UI Toolkit, URP, multiplayer, IAP) to the coding agent with one terminal command. Unity 6+.
